name: Near Edge
description: Cut the target's will with the near edge of the pair so the first line of the guard parts.

name: Far Edge
description: Send the far edge past the opened guard to nick the deeper layer of the target's will.

name: Edge Measure
description: Lay both edges against a foe's soul and read the gap between them as a measure of its width.

name: Parting Edges
description: Draw the two edges apart across the target's focus so the technique they hold splits and fails.

name: Edge Weave
description: Weave the near cut and the far cut together in one pass so the guard is cleared and struck.

name: Shear Hold
description: Close the two edges like shears on the target's will and hold them there so it cannot move.

name: Shearing Edges
description: Bring both edges together through the target's soul with such force that the guard is cut in two.

name: Twinned Sunder
description: Gather both edges into one blade over several breaths and split a strongly guarded will down its centre.

name: Converging Edges
description: Let both edges run in from either side of the soul and meet at its core to wound it past any guard.

name: Weighing Touch
description: Touch a soul lightly and judge the weight of its will as a merchant weighs a coin.

name: Verdict Strike
description: Strike once and clean with the full weight of a settled judgement upon the target's will.

name: Balancing Weight
description: Set an equal weight of will against a pressing soul and hold the balance so it cannot tip.

name: Measure Out
description: Measure the force of the next blow exactly so that none is wasted and none is held back.

name: Scale Tip
description: Tip the balance of the target's will with a small push so their poise swings and fails.

name: Weighted Press
description: Add weight to the target's will pan by pan until it sinks and they can no longer raise a technique.

name: Balanced Blow
description: Strike with force matched exactly to the target's own so the blow cannot be turned or softened.

name: Judgement Stroke
description: Pass a single stroke of soul force through every defence of a will found wanting.

name: Twin Judgement
description: Let two judgements fall in turn so the second sentence lands where the first has weakened the soul.

name: Passed Sentence
description: Pronounce the weight of a foe's whole will in a single stroke that wounds the soul past all guard.

name: Far Gaze
description: Lift the sense high and far and see the distant souls below as small points of light.

name: Pinion Strike
description: Beat a hard wing of soul force across the target's will and knock their focus aside.

name: Plume Ward
description: Fan the soul out in layered feathers that catch a blow and bleed its force away.

name: Thermal Lift
description: Ride a rising current of will so the user's strikes gather height and speed before they fall.

name: Raptor Grip
description: Seize the target's will in a clutch of talons and hold it fast against the next stroke.

name: Talon Sweep
description: Rake the talons low across every soul in the user's front and tear at their composure.

name: Sky Stoop
description: Fall from a great height of will in one steep dive and drive the point through a guard.

name: Wheeling Descent
description: Circle above the foe in widening rings and then fall in one stroke that follows the last pass.

name: Striking Zenith
description: Climb to the highest point of the will and fall from there on one soul with a wound that ignores guard.

name: Will Draw
description: Draw soul force into the hollow of the will until the basin stands full and still.

name: Stream Touch
description: Let a thin stream of stored force run to the target and touch their will with a cold sting.

name: Sluice Ward
description: Open and close gates of will to bleed the force from an incoming soul strike into the basin.

name: Depth Sound
description: Lower a line of attention into a soul and read how deep its will runs.

name: Whirlpool Turn
description: Spin the target's thoughts in a slow whirl until they lose which way their purpose lies.

name: Rapids Strike
description: Send the force down in a quick broken rush that hits the target's will again and again.

name: Silt Drag
description: Cloud the target's will with heavy silt until every thought moves slowly and sinks.

name: Spate
description: Break the basin's edge and let a sudden rush of force wash over every soul ahead.

name: Will Burst
description: Hold the basin full for several breaths and then release it so the target's will is flooded flat.

name: Torrent Unmaking
description: Send the whole river through one soul in a torrent that wears away will beneath every guard.

name: Lead Lance
description: Advance the soul lance at the front and thrust it hard at the target's will.

name: Following Guard
description: Hold the soul guard close behind the lance to cover the user the instant the thrust ends.

name: Linked Sense
description: Feel through lance and guard together and learn where a foe's attack will fall next.

name: Guard Lend
description: Lend the guard's steadiness to the lance so the thrust keeps true under pressure.

name: Lance Return
description: Beat a soul strike aside with the lance and snap the point back toward the striker.

name: Lance Over Guard
description: Thrust the lance over the raised guard so the strike lands while the shield stays up.

name: Guard Over Lance
description: Drop the guard across the lance so a blow is met and the thrust follows from behind it.

name: Twinned Advance
description: Press forward in alternating steps of lance and guard so the user is never open as it closes.

name: Linked Pair
description: Link the target's will to the lance and the guard together so it can neither strike nor withdraw.

name: Guarded Pierce
description: Pierce the guard of will while the shield covers the user from the answering blow.

name: Unbroken Pair
description: Draw a hostile soul strike into the guard and return its force through the lance in one turn.

name: Heading Take
description: Fix the heading from the user to a foe's soul and note what lies between them.

name: Sworn Thrust
description: Thrust along the sworn heading with a force that does not slip or glance.

name: Sworn Anchor
description: Stand on the pledge so firmly that a pushing soul finds nothing to move.

name: Keel Steady
description: Settle a deep keel of will beneath the soul so each stroke rides level and strong.

name: Heading Clamp
description: Hold the target to the heading of the user's force so their will cannot veer.

name: Pledged Stab
description: Stab along the heading with a pledge behind it that refuses to be turned aside.

name: Oath Drag
description: Drag the target's will along the sworn line against its own wish and hold it there.

name: Bearing Strike
description: Strike straight along the bearing with all the sworn force behind the point.

name: Bearing Seal
description: Seal the target's will to one heading so they cannot turn their power to any other course.

name: Heading Unmaking
description: Drive the whole sworn heading through a single soul and unmake what stands in its line past guard.

name: Long Look
description: Stretch the attention far across the distance and touch a distant soul with it.

name: Reach Cut
description: Cut at a soul well beyond arm's length with a flat arc of stretched force.

name: Distance Ward
description: Hold a ward at far range so a distant soul strike spends itself before it arrives.

name: Far Press
description: Lean on a far foe's will from across the field until their techniques come slow.

name: Distant Prick
description: Send a needle the length of the field and prick one soul among many.

name: Wide Sweep
description: Sweep a long flat arc of soul force across every foe at the user's front.

name: Farthest Cut
description: Gather force along the bearing for many breaths and cut a soul at the very edge of reach.

name: Unbroken Reach
description: Hold a line of force to a far foe without a break so their will stays sealed from help.

name: Far Unmaking
description: Throw the bearing across a vast distance and wound a single far soul beyond all guard.

name: Outbreath Cut
description: Cut the target's will with a thin edge carried on one outward breath.

name: Sworn Gust
description: Loose a sudden gust of sworn force that buffets the target's resolve.

name: Air Screen
description: Draw a thin screen of moving air round the soul that thins and scatters a soul strike.

name: Draft Taste
description: Taste the draft that passes through a foe's soul to learn what guard it carries.

name: Whirling Edge
description: Spin an edge of wind through the field and cut at every will it meets.

name: Scouring Oath
description: Scour the target's will with a steady sworn wind until its edges wear down.

name: Blast Rake
description: Rake the target's guard with a hard blast that tears open its outer layer.

name: Draft Unmaking
description: Let the sworn wind blow through a will until it has taken most of its strength away.

name: Sworn Whirl
description: Gather a great whirl of sworn force and loose it to strip the guard from every soul in range.

name: Absolute Gust
description: Send one perfect gust of sworn wind through a soul so that it wounds the core past any guard.

name: Open Palm
description: Strike with the mind left open and nothing held back so the blow lands plain and hard.

name: Lucid Ward
description: Keep the mind so clear that a hostile soul finds no hidden thing to seize.

name: Truthful Look
description: Look at a soul and read at once what it tries to hide behind its guard.

name: Candid Cut
description: Cut plainly at the weakest point in sight with no feint and no delay.

name: Naked Thought
description: Show the target their own thoughts laid out bare until they can no longer tell them from the user's.

name: Unveiling
description: Strip a veil from the target's focus and leave their half formed plan in plain sight.

name: Bared Soul
description: Lay a foe's soul bare of every cover and press upon it until it cannot rally.

name: Stripped Will
description: Peel the layers of resolve from the target one after another until little remains to act with.

name: Exposed Core
description: Open the target's soul to its core with plain intent and strike the core directly past all guard.

name: Sharp Breeze
description: Send a thin sharp breeze of soul force across the target's will to nick the surface.

name: Upwind Guard
description: Turn the soul to face the oncoming force and hold a guard that parts it round the user.

name: Veering Turn
description: Veer sharply aside in the will as a blow arrives and let it pass along the edge.

name: Breeze Taste
description: Test the air round a soul for the faint shift that shows where its force is leaning.

name: Wind Gathering
description: Gather the scattered breezes of the will into one steady wind ready for the cut.

name: Razor Draft
description: Draw the wind to a razor line and shave a layer from the target's guard.

name: Cutting Current
description: Ride a fast current of wind into the target and cut across the grain of their will.

name: Lee Grip
description: Pull the target into the still air behind the user and hold them where no force can reach.

name: Slicing Squall
description: Burst a squall of blade-thin wind over every soul in front and cut their guards to ribbons.

name: Edge Run
description: Run along the very edge of the wind in a chain of cuts that leaves no gap between them.

name: Edge Absolute
description: Cut from the thin gap the wind leaves with a stroke that wounds the soul beneath all guard.
